factProposals.value: A human reviewer must decide every AI finding (approve, edit or reject) before feedback can be prepared; the prepared feedback names that reviewer, and the review is then locked.
Only a named human may act on a review: AI/system identities (claude, system, bot, ...) and blank ids are refused for every reviewer action and for preparing feedback.
Prepared feedback is a numbered list of the approved findings in the reviewer's wording, saved once per review as ready_to_post for the posting step.

Reviewer actions are an append-only log (reviewer, time, action) kept beside the unchanged AI draft, so each review's AI draft and human edits are both preserved; stored in git-ignored local files, not SQL Server.
The comment author's display name and the Basecamp web link (app_url) are now taken from the Basecamp API and shown to the reviewer; they never enter the audit trail or logs.
Two reviewer roles were identified for sign-in: Reviewer and Admin (Admin also manages the reviewer list); planned as STORY-014.

decisions.statement: Reviewer text may be 2,000 characters per finding and 10,000 for the whole feedback, while the AI suggestion stays capped at 400.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-29: in the history extract the longest reviewer reply was 4,513 characters (ST2, median 903); the AI cap bounds token cost

decisions.statement: Editing a finding accepts it in the reviewer's words; no separate approve click.
decisions.rationale: fewer clicks; a later reject still overrides it

decisions.statement: Empty feedback is never prepared; when nothing is approved the reviewer adds a note instead.
decisions.rationale: nothing blank is ever sent to a student; reuses the REQ-011 guardrail

decisions.statement: Reviewer identity is a temporary, unverified X-Reviewer-Id header until sign-in with Basecamp (STORY-014) lands, which must precede real posting.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-29; REQ-012 requires Basecamp OAuth for authentication

decisions.statement: Images in feedback and AI polish of reviewer text are separate stories (STORY-015, STORY-016), not part of STORY-005.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-29; AI polish must return a suggestion the reviewer accepts, never replace approved text

limitations.statement: The reviewer id is not verified: anyone who can reach the API can claim any reviewer id (AI ids are still refused).
The reviewer page accepts text only; images in feedback are planned as STORY-015.
Preparing feedback does not move the Review Queue item to 'Feedback Generated'; the in-memory queue has no status update yet.
Student name and Basecamp link are available only for comments retrieved through the Basecamp API.
